variants.headline: Business plan abandoned before opening
variants.body: The founder {founder} has abandoned the plan for {business} before opening. Our assessment favours {target} over a verdict that confuses an adverse interpretation with an established fact.

variants.headline: An intended company will not open
variants.body: The planned {business} will not open: {founder} has given up the plan. Our assessment favours {target} over a verdict that confuses an adverse interpretation with an established fact.

variants.headline: A household's business plan ends
variants.body: The business plan made by {founder} has been abandoned before the company opened. Our assessment favours {target} over a verdict that confuses an adverse interpretation with an established fact.
